original_test_intent: Exercise every populated front-side storage device for 12 hours at 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails and verify stable, error-free storage behavior.
original_method: Do not execute until the owner supplies immutable front-bay-to-serial/WWN/namespace mappings, protected-device exclusions, an approved non-destructive or explicitly destructive SST profile, and measurable integrity/performance/error/thermal criteria; then a qualified operator may establish the margin condition, run the complete bay set with continuous telemetry, restore nominal conditions and verify data/device health.
manual_activity: After resolution, an operator controls chamber/rails and supervises physical storage margin testing.
required_inputs: Boot, mounted, swap, LVM, RAID and protected-device exclusions
SST version and exact read/write/data-set/runtime/concurrency profile
Destructive-write authorization and backup if applicable
Per-drive integrity, media-error, latency/performance, thermal and reset thresholds
Abort, cleanup, nominal restoration and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Never infer a disk target from /dev naming
Do not erase logs or run undefined writes
Require disposable-target and backup proof for destructive coverage
Use calibrated rail measurements and OOB abort
Preserve pre/post SMART/NVMe and platform logs
agent_execution_scope: May validate supplied maps and analyze captured artifacts after the blocker is resolved
Must not select storage targets, initiate stress or decide DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Define authoritative bay population, workload and acceptance oracle
Supervise low-rail execution and determine verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Physical boundary is correct, but 'every front-side drive' is unsafe without immutable identity and workload definition.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No command until identities, exclusions, profile and criteria are approved; thereafter use the pinned SST invocation against only approved targets.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All front-side storage, 40C, -5% 5V/3.3V and 12 hours remain required.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a signed target matrix and per-device evidence plan before any low-voltage storage stress.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the absent target safety, workload semantics, acceptance oracle, integrity evidence and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Selecting an arbitrary 'front disk' cannot prove all-bay coverage and may destroy protected data.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The Master criteria are procedural repetition, so neither a clean log nor completed duration has an approved pass threshold.

project_override_considerations: Project storage policy must define target disposability, endurance budget, concurrent versus sequential bay coverage and whether performance degradation is evaluated at negative margin.
expected_evidence: Approved front-bay identity and exclusion matrix
SST binary/config checksum and exact target list
Per-drive workload completion, integrity, SMART/NVMe error and reset evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Criteria field repeats setup/execution steps rather than specifying any expected result, while the title claims all-front-storage margin coverage; the preserved source therefore lacks an acceptance oracle.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Target identity, safe workload semantics and measurable acceptance are indeterminate; these are irreducible execution and verdict blockers, not merely a missing package.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row22 Wistron-Margin-00021-V002: provide every front-bay serial/WWN/namespace/BDF/slot map and protected-target exclusions, approved SST version/profile/destructive policy, 12-hour per-drive integrity/performance/media-error/thermal/reset thresholds, 40C/-5% rail tolerances, abort, cleanup and nominal restoration.

review_improvement: Prevents an undefined all-disk stress from being treated as safe or review-complete and exposes the missing Master acceptance contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: At low rail margin, a drive, backplane lane or shared power domain may reset without terminating a coarse workload. Proof therefore needs immutable per-bay identities and per-device error/integrity evidence. Because the Criteria supply no oracle, static review cannot translate successful command completion into DUT acceptance.
